snippet.title: COP BASTARD - Release Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
COP BASTARD is a classic FPS set in early ’90s Japan. Play as a tough detective and blast through waves of yakuza in relentless action inspired by ’90s films. No puzzles, perks or upgrades - just corridors, enemies and the chance to spit in their faces. 

Wishlist game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1742440/COP_BASTARD/
